notes: «حدثنا أبي» is a bare relation (the father of Ubayd Allah) and is the first «أبي» in the text
«سمع أبا عبد الله» is a link by rule 5
Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf asks Bilal inside a scene the Sulami witnessed: not a link; Bilal, the one asked who answers, is last
«- يعني ابن حفص بن عمر بن سعد -» and «قال أبو داود هو أبو عبد الله مولى بني تيم» are glosses, left out
